title: The pig in the cabbages
petition: A pig rooted through Mara's cabbages after its gate was left open.
label: seek-small-reparation

title: One hen short
petition: A wheelwright repaired a cart and received only one of two promised hens.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The copper pan
petition: A borrowed copper pan has not been returned after three market days.
label: request-return

title: The goose with two owners
petition: Two villagers claim the same goose and both point to old markings.
label: find-witness

title: Wet flour at the mill
petition: A delivery arrived soaked, and the miller disputes payment for spoiled flour.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The insult by the scales
petition: A market insult has become a neighborhood feud, but no property was damaged.
label: propose-settlement

title: The moved boundary stone
petition: A boundary stone was moved, but nobody agrees when it happened.
label: sworn-account

title: The debt after harvest
petition: A debt is acknowledged, but the debtor cannot pay until the next harvest.
label: propose-settlement

title: The sour look at vespers
petition: One villager complains of a sour look and nothing more.
label: let-rest

title: The pruning knife
petition: A pruning knife was borrowed for one afternoon and kept for a week.
label: request-return

title: The broken fence rail
petition: A neighbor's ram broke a fence rail and escaped through it twice.
label: seek-small-reparation

title: The thin ale barrel
petition: An ale barrel arrived half full, and the carrier denies tapping it.
label: find-witness

title: The orphan's rent
petition: Rent is demanded from an orphan's holding under a charter clause nobody can settle.
label: refer-higher

title: The narrow measure
petition: A seller used a narrow measure for grain and admits the measure is not standard.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The lost ribbon
petition: A ribbon was misplaced during a dance and no one saw who took it.
label: let-rest

title: The tally stick
petition: A tally stick shows bread delivered, but the buyer says the marks were read wrongly.
label: sworn-account

title: The blocked cart path
petition: A cart path used for years was blocked with stacked firewood.
label: propose-settlement

title: The cudgel threat
petition: A debt argument ended with threats and a raised cudgel outside the chapel.
label: refer-higher

title: The watered milk
petition: Milk sold as fresh was watered, and the seller says everyone does it.
label: seek-small-reparation

title: The Sunday cloak
petition: A borrowed Sunday cloak was returned torn at the shoulder.
label: seek-small-reparation

title: The goat in the churchyard
petition: A goat wandered through the churchyard and ate wreaths before anyone caught it.
label: seek-small-reparation

title: The apology already made
petition: A harsh remark was answered by a public apology and shared bread.
label: let-rest

title: The cracked seal
petition: A lease bears a cracked seal, and the parties dispute whether it binds them.
label: sworn-account

title: The bridge toll
petition: The bridge keeper doubled a toll under orders nobody in the village has seen.
label: refer-higher

title: The borrowed firewood
petition: A neighbor took firewood during a cold night and offers to replace it.
label: propose-settlement

title: The split shoe
petition: A new shoe split after one day on the road, and the cobbler admits the stitching failed.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The nod at the stall
petition: A buyer nodded at a price, walked away, and denies making a bargain.
label: find-witness

title: The muddy well
petition: A household muddied the shared well while cleaning hides.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The festival bench
petition: Two families argue over who sat on a festival bench first.
label: let-rest

title: The lamb with a blurred mark
petition: A lamb's mark is blurred, and two flocks claim it after rain.
label: find-witness

title: The ferry after dusk
petition: A ferry was paid in advance but never crossed before dusk.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The fevered debtor
petition: A debtor admits the sum but is ill and unable to work this week.
label: propose-settlement

title: Ducks in the herb bed
petition: Three ducks trampled an herb bed after a latch was left loose.
label: seek-small-reparation

title: Two eggs missing
petition: A potter was promised twelve eggs for mending a jug and received ten.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The ladder kept overnight
petition: A ladder lent for one roof repair was still missing the next morning.
label: request-return

title: The crowing rooster
petition: Two households claim a rooster that crossed the lane at dawn.
label: find-witness

title: Cracked oil jars
petition: Oil jars arrived cracked after a rough cart ride.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: Words under the bell
petition: A shouted insult under the bell tower has drawn both families into quarrel.
label: propose-settlement

title: The crooked ditch
petition: A drainage ditch now bends into a neighbor's strip, but no one knows when it changed.
label: sworn-account

title: Payment after lambing
petition: The debtor admits owing wool money but asks to pay after lambing season.
label: propose-settlement

title: The feathered hat
petition: A feathered hat was mocked, and the owner asks for law to mend pride.
label: let-rest

title: The eel net
petition: An eel net was borrowed and not returned before the next tide.
label: request-return

title: The weak cart axle
petition: A new axle snapped on its first loaded trip, and the maker admits bad wood.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The steward's secret order
petition: A steward claims a secret order lets him seize grain from a widow's store.
label: refer-higher

title: The soup pot at night
petition: A hungry neighbor took a soup pot and offers to bring it back filled.
label: propose-settlement

title: The heavy counterweight
petition: A counterweight was heavier than marked, and the seller admits using it.
label: seek-full-reparation

title: The bridge brawl
petition: A toll dispute became a brawl blocking the bridge.
label: refer-higher

title: The missing pewter pin
petition: A pewter pin is missing after a feast, with no witness and little value.
label: let-rest
